title: Revit governed Design Option visibility
test_intent: Determine whether applicable Revit views inherit the governed project primary Design Option or use a traceable view-specific option basis only where required for the declared purpose.

applicability.applies_when: The tested Revit model uses Design Options and contains views whose visibility depends on option state.
applicability.not_applicable_when: The tested model contains no Design Options or the tested scope contains no view affected by Design Option visibility.

required_evidence: inventory of project Design Option sets and options
governed primary-option basis or project decision record
inventory of applicable views and their Design Option visibility mode
view-specific option-set and option identity where explicitly selected

result_logic.pass: Every applicable view either inherits the governed project primary option or has an explicit view-specific option basis that is traceable to the declared view purpose and approved project state.
result_logic.fail: An applicable view displays an ungoverned option, uses an unexplained By View or named-option override, or assumes a discipline/default primary option not supported by the governed project configuration.
result_logic.not_applicable: The model or tested scope does not use Design Options in a way that affects view visibility.
result_logic.indeterminate: The applicable project primary-option basis, option-set identity, or expected view-specific option state is unavailable or incomplete.

provenance.migration_note: Round 005 ATS converts the source Design Option visibility guidance into testable project-bound conformance without inventing enterprise primary options or option naming.
